transcript: America and Britain almost went to war over one pig A farmer caught it eating his potatoes so he shot it Problem the farmer was American the pig was British He offered10 the owner wanted 100 Worse both countries claimed the island America sent over 400 soldiers Britain sent five warships The governor wanted the Americans gone The admiral said no not over a pig So both sides just stayed for 12 years and partied together Then a German emperor settled it The island went to America Total casualties one pig Team farmer or team pig
